cues.en: In the previous lecture, we had set up the home roots in this lecture.
cues.zh: 上一堂課設定了首頁路由。這堂課，

cues.en: Let's now work on the configuration settings.
cues.zh: 我們來處理組態設定。

cues.en: So what you're going to do is let's close all this.
cues.zh: 先關閉這些畫面。

cues.en: Then in the back end slash app directory which is this we're going to create a new folder.
cues.zh: 在 backend/app 目錄，也就是這裡，新增資料夾。

cues.en: We're going to call this folder call like that.
cues.zh: 命名為 core。

cues.en: Then within call we're going to create a new file.
cues.zh: 在 core 裡新增檔案，

cues.en: We're going to have double underscore init double underscore dot pi and a config dot pi.
cues.zh: 我們要有 __init__.py 與 config.py。

cues.en: So you can go back to call.
cues.zh: 回到 core，

cues.en: Then create a new file that's going to be config dot pi.
cues.zh: 新增 config.py。

cues.en: And so our new file and folder structure should look something like this.
cues.zh: 新的檔案與資料夾結構應該像這樣。

cues.en: With the core folder being at the same level as the API folder, all within the app directory.
cues.zh: core 與 api 資料夾同一層，都位於 app 目錄裡。

cues.en: Then within core we're going to open config dot pi file.
cues.zh: 在 core 中開啟 config.py。

cues.en: And this is going to be the file where we're going to be adding settings that are going to be used across our project.
cues.zh: 這個檔案會加入整個專案共用的設定。

cues.en: So let's start on that.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: So at the top we're going to say from pedantic settings we're going to import the base settings and the settings config like that.
cues.zh: 在最上方，從 pydantic_settings 匯入 BaseSettings 與 SettingsConfigDict。

cues.en: And so the best settings.
cues.zh: 其中 BaseSettings，

cues.en: This is just a class that fast API uses to create settings.
cues.zh: 是 FastAPI 這裡用來建立設定的類別。

cues.en: And it's going to validate the settings using Pydantic type system and provide type ins.
cues.zh: 它會透過 Pydantic 型別系統驗證設定，並提供型別提示。

cues.en: Then the settings config dict is a configuration dictionary that is going to allow us to specify the settings for the application.
cues.zh: SettingsConfigDict 則是設定字典，讓我們指定應用程式的設定。

cues.en: Then we can say from typing we're going to import literal.
cues.zh: 接著從 typing 匯入 Literal。

cues.en: Literal is a type hint that allows us to specify the type of a variable as a specific value.
cues.zh: Literal 是型別提示，可將變數限制為特定的值。

cues.en: Then we can have a class and we're going to call this settings.
cues.zh: 接著建立 Settings 類別，

cues.en: And it's going to subclass the base settings.
cues.zh: 繼承 BaseSettings。

cues.en: Then within our settings class we're going to define a setting for the environment.
cues.zh: 在 Settings 類別中，定義環境設定。

cues.en: So you can see here environment that's going to be literal.
cues.zh: 這裡的 ENVIRONMENT 使用 Literal。

cues.en: And we're going to have three types of environment either local staging or production.
cues.zh: 有三種環境：local、staging 或 production。

cues.en: And since we're still in local development we're going to set our environment to local like that.
cues.zh: 因為目前仍是本機開發，所以預設設為 local。

cues.en: If I can explain for this environment setting, we're using the literal type because we only want to allow the values of local staging and production.
cues.zh: 解釋一下，ENVIRONMENT 使用 Literal，是因為我們只想允許 local、staging 與 production 這三個值。

cues.en: That's why we are setting the environment as a type of literal.
cues.zh: 所以將 ENVIRONMENT 設為 Literal 型別。

cues.en: Then we're going to define a model config, which is going to be a configuration dictionary.
cues.zh: 接著定義 model_config，這是一個設定字典，

cues.en: That is going to allow us to specify the settings for the application.
cues.zh: 讓我們指定應用程式設定。

cues.en: As you can see model config that's going to be settings config dict.
cues.zh: model_config 設為 SettingsConfigDict。

cues.en: Then we're going to pass the environment variable file.
cues.zh: 接著傳入環境變數檔。

cues.en: And in our case it's going to be the dot env dot local.
cues.zh: 這裡是 .env.local。

cues.en: And so if you look at where we are right now we have to move up one level two levels two dot envs.
cues.zh: 看一下目前的位置，必須往上移一層、兩層，到 .envs，

cues.en: Then a slash dot env dot local.
cues.zh: 再接上 /.env.local。

cues.en: Like that.
cues.zh: 像這樣。

cues.en: That's where our environment variable file is.
cues.zh: 環境變數檔就在那裡。

cues.en: Then we're going to ignore any empty environment variables by saying env underscore ignore empty.
cues.zh: 接著用 env_ignore_empty，忽略空的環境變數。

cues.en: And you're going to set that to true.
cues.zh: 將它設為 True。

cues.en: Then we're going to ignore any extra environment variables by saying extra setting that to ignore like that.
cues.zh: 再用 extra='ignore'，忽略額外的環境變數。

cues.en: Then after the model config we're going to specify the API version.
cues.zh: model_config 之後，指定 API 版本。

cues.en: So you can say here API underscore v1 underscore string.
cues.zh: 名稱是 API_V1_STR。

cues.en: Remember we had set this in our environment variable.
cues.zh: 記得，之前已在環境變數檔設定過。

cues.en: This is going to be of type string.
cues.zh: 型別是 str。

cues.en: And by default it's going to be an empty string because we're going to be reading this value from our env file.
cues.zh: 預設為空字串，因為要從環境變數檔讀取值。

cues.en: If you remember open dot env dot local, we had set up this API version one string.
cues.zh: 記得開啟 .env.local，我們設定過 API_V1_STR。

cues.en: And so that is what is going to be populated right here.
cues.zh: 它的值就會填入這裡。

cues.en: The next we're going to set a project name.
cues.zh: 接著設定 PROJECT_NAME。

cues.en: Project name is going to be of type string.
cues.zh: PROJECT_NAME 的型別是 str。

cues.en: And we're going to set this to an empty string because it's going to be read from our env local file as this project name.
cues.zh: 預設為空字串，因為會從 .env.local 的 PROJECT_NAME 讀取。

cues.en: Then we're going to do the same for the project description.
cues.zh: PROJECT_DESCRIPTION 也一樣。

cues.en: So I can just go to env local.
cues.zh: 到 .env.local，

cues.en: Copy that.
cues.zh: 複製它。

cues.en: Come back here.
cues.zh: 回到這裡，

cues.en: Set project description to a type of string.
cues.zh: 將 PROJECT_DESCRIPTION 的型別設為 str，

cues.en: Then default it to an empty string.
cues.zh: 預設值設為空字串。

cues.en: Then we're going to do the same for the site name.
cues.zh: SITE_NAME 也一樣。

cues.en: So copy site name from the dot env dot local file.
cues.zh: 從 .env.local 複製 SITE_NAME。

cues.en: Go to config, set it up.
cues.zh: 到 config.py 設定。

cues.en: It's of type string.
cues.zh: 型別是 str。

cues.en: Set it to an empty string like that.
cues.zh: 設為空字串。

cues.en: Then at the bottom we're going to create an instance of the settings class by saying settings.
cues.zh: 接著在最下方建立 Settings 的執行個體，命名為 settings。

cues.en: That's going to be a settings like that.
cues.zh: 設為 Settings()。

cues.en: Then we can save that file.
cues.zh: 再儲存檔案。

cues.en: Now that we have our configuration done, we're going to go back to the main.py file and make some amendments so I can open Main.py file.
cues.zh: 組態設定完成後，回到 main.py，做一些修改。

cues.en: Remember we're opening the one in backend slash app.
cues.zh: 記得，是開啟 backend/app 裡的那個。

cues.en: This is the one.
cues.zh: 就是這個。

cues.en: Then we're going to make some changes.
cues.zh: 接著修改。

cues.en: We can now say from dot API dot main we're going to import the API router.
cues.zh: 從 .api.main 匯入 api_router。

cues.en: Then from.co dot config we're going to import our settings the ones that you've just defined right now.
cues.zh: 再從 .core.config 匯入剛才定義的 settings。

cues.en: Then we're going to initialize our fast API by passing in the title.
cues.zh: 接著初始化 FastAPI，傳入 title。

cues.en: This time the title is not going to be hardcoded.
cues.zh: 這次不會把標題直接寫死。

cues.en: It's going to be read from our settings.
cues.zh: 而是從 settings 讀取。

cues.en: And remember our settings reads from our environment variable file which is this.
cues.zh: 記得，settings 又會讀取這個環境變數檔。

cues.en: So now within Main.py we can remove all this hardcoded stuff.
cues.zh: 所以在 main.py 中，可以移除這些寫死的內容。

cues.en: And we can say the title is going to be settings dot project name.
cues.zh: 將 title 設為 settings.PROJECT_NAME。

cues.en: Then the description get rid of this hardcoded description.
cues.zh: 再移除寫死的 description。

cues.en: This is going to be settings dot project description.
cues.zh: 改成 settings.PROJECT_DESCRIPTION。

cues.en: Then the docs URL for swagger UI.
cues.zh: 接著是 Swagger UI 的 docs_url。

cues.en: This is going to be a URL, so you can use f strings.
cues.zh: 這是一個網址，可以用 f-string。

cues.en: And we're going to pass in a settings dot API version one string, then slash docs for swagger UI.
cues.zh: 傳入 settings.API_V1_STR，再接 /docs，作為 Swagger UI 的網址。

cues.en: Then for the doc underscore URL that's going to be f strings again.
cues.zh: 接著 redoc_url 也用 f-string。

cues.en: And we're going to pass in settings dot API version one string, then slash doc.
cues.zh: 傳入 settings.API_V1_STR，再接 /redoc。

cues.en: Then for the open API URL.
cues.zh: 然後是 openapi_url。

cues.en: And this is the URL that is going to be used to access the OpenAPI JSON.
cues.zh: 這個網址用來存取 OpenAPI JSON。

cues.en: And so you can see OpenAPI URL that's going to be f strings.
cues.zh: openapi_url 同樣使用 f-string。

cues.en: Then you're going to pass in settings dot API version one string, then slash open API dot JSON like that.
cues.zh: 傳入 settings.API_V1_STR，再接 /openapi.json。

cues.en: Then you can save the file and then at the bottom.
cues.zh: 接著儲存檔案，到最下方。

cues.en: Now we're going to add the API router to the app by saying app dot include router.
cues.zh: 透過 app.include_router，將 API 路由器加入應用程式。

cues.en: We're not going to pass our API router with a prefix.
cues.zh: 現在傳入 api_router，並指定 prefix。

cues.en: The prefix is going to be settings dot API version one string like that.
cues.zh: 前綴是 settings.API_V1_STR。

cues.en: Then you can save the file and the error that you had before will disappear.
cues.zh: 儲存檔案，先前的錯誤就會消失。

cues.en: Now, with all the changes that you have made, we can go back to the terminal and test things out.
cues.zh: 完成所有修改後，可以回到終端機測試。

cues.en: So go back to the terminal.
cues.zh: 回到終端機。

cues.en: Then let's start the first API server by.
cues.zh: 啟動 FastAPI 伺服器，

cues.en: Now we're going to CD into the backend directory, which you already are.
cues.zh: 先 cd 進 backend 目錄；目前已在裡面。

cues.en: Let me see.
cues.zh: 看一下。

cues.en: Yeah we're reading the backend directory.
cues.zh: 沒錯，我們在 backend 目錄。

cues.en: Then now we're going to CD into the app directory.
cues.zh: 接著 cd 進 app 目錄。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: Now we can run our first API dev like that.
cues.zh: 現在執行 fastapi dev。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: Our server is started on port 8000.
cues.zh: 伺服器在 8000 連接埠啟動。

cues.en: So you can go back to our browser.
cues.zh: 回到瀏覽器。

cues.en: And this time let's go to localhost 8000.
cues.zh: 這次前往 localhost:8000。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: You're going to see that the route no longer works because this time remember we have this API version one string set up as an environment variable.
cues.zh: 這個路由已經無法使用，因為記得，我們在環境變數中設定了 API_V1_STR，

cues.en: And in our main.py it's added as a prefix.
cues.zh: 並在 main.py 將它加為前綴。

cues.en: So we can go back to our browser.
cues.zh: 回到瀏覽器。

cues.en: This time it's going to be localhost 8000 slash API slash v1.
cues.zh: 這次是 localhost:8000/api/v1。

cues.en: Then we want to go to the home route which is slash home.
cues.zh: 要前往首頁路由，再加上 /home。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: As you can see we still get the welcome message, but this time it's on API v1.
cues.zh: 依然能取得歡迎訊息，但這次路徑是 /api/v1，

cues.en: Home.
cues.zh: 再接 /home。

cues.en: The same applies to our documentation.
cues.zh: 文件也一樣。

cues.en: We need now to go to localhost 8000, then slash API, then slash v1, then slash docs to open up this documentation.
cues.zh: 現在要前往 localhost:8000/api/v1/docs，才能開啟文件。

cues.en: The same applies to the doc URL.
cues.zh: ReDoc 網址也是如此。

cues.en: If you go to the previous URL that's not going to work.
cues.zh: 先前的網址不會再有效。

cues.en: It's now going to be on slash API, slash v1, then slash doc like that.
cues.zh: 現在是 /api/v1/redoc。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: All our URLs are now working as expected, and since that's the case we can now go back to VS code.
cues.zh: 所有網址都正常運作，既然如此，回到 VS Code。

cues.en: Go to the git client and we're going to commit our changes.
cues.zh: 前往 Git 用戶端，提交變更。

cues.en: So you can see this is Archer.
cues.zh: 這是一次 chore。

cues.en: And the message can be add env variables and config settings like that.
cues.zh: 訊息可以寫 add env variables and config settings。

cues.en: Then we can make the commit good.
cues.zh: 接著提交，很好。

cues.en: In this lecture we set up the environment variables and set up the configuration settings.
cues.zh: 這堂課設定了環境變數與組態，
